method: One warm-up; rotated variants. standard/control are the same frozen 0.18.1 std.json.Value parser; current is the production boundary. Scan-only/depth experiments overlap full parse and are not additive or fully equivalent validation. standard_dom uses the same Value parser, a counter above its explicit arena and a separate backing counter; token traffic is nested allocation activity, not a timing subtraction. Logical outstanding requests are reclaimed in bulk by arena release; only backing must reach zero. Encoding/checks are outside timers. No production clocks or standard-library changes.
